text: Okay, be honest. How many things did you save this month... and never open again?
That video you’d watch later. The post you loved. That article. The screenshot you swore you’d remember.
They’re all still out there, buried across a dozen different apps.
That’s exactly why we made Makeena.
From any app, just share to Makeena. Videos, posts, articles, screenshots... it all lands in one place.
Then Makeena gets to work. It analyzes every save, summarizes it, and pulls out the key points, so you’ll always remember why you kept it.
It even connects each save to related ones you’ve kept before, so your ideas start building on each other.
Makeena. Everything you save, finally useful.
